lean.name: UpperTheory.V.Af.NumberSp4
lean.note: This proposition asks for one size-controlled nonzero integer whose $\ell$-adic absolute value is at most the product of the $\ell$-adic absolute values of the differences between the Frobenius traces of admissible $\mathrm{GSp}_4$ representations and the Eisenstein trace. The proposition is outside the final dependency cone. The compiled proof uses a unitary-group congruence number.
